notes.subject: kunku
notes.rationale: שאון rendered 'noise/uproar' as KJV/JPS; alternatives read it as 'destruction' (YLt 'desolation') from the root's implication

notes.subject: o basigi
notes.rationale: העביר המועד: 'he let the appointed time pass' (KJV/ASV) vs 'the appointed time has passed' (reading the verbs impersonally, cf. Geneva)

notes.subject: Egyptian fugitives
notes.rationale: the cry of v16 is quoted; the taunt against Pharaoh is spoken by the fleeing soldiers

translation: U ye wele o yɔrɔ na ko: Parao, Mitsrayim (Misira) masakɛ, ye kunku dɔrɔn ye; a ye waati-jɔlen min tun bɛ, o basigi.
